sort.title_vi: Chỗ trống cần too, so hay such? Xếp mỗi câu vào đúng nhóm.

groups.name: too (+ adj + to V)
items: I'm ___ tired to go jogging tonight.
The soup was ___ salty for me to eat.
It's ___ late to drink coffee now.
groups.rule_vi: **too + adj + to V** (hoặc for sb + to V): quá … nên không thể. Dấu hiệu: sau tính từ có ==to go==, ==for me to eat==. __Thấy 'to V' phía sau, nghĩ ngay tới too.__

groups.name: so (+ adj/adv + that)
items: Vinh ran ___ fast that he won the race.
I was ___ hungry that I ate three bowls.
She has ___ much energy that she never stops.
groups.rule_vi: **so + adj/adv + that**: quá … đến nỗi. Dấu hiệu: sau chỗ trống là tính từ, trạng từ hoặc ==much== rồi tới ==that==. __Không có danh từ ngay sau chỗ trống → dùng so.__

groups.name: such (+ a/an + adj + N + that)
items: It was ___ a long walk that my legs hurt.
We had ___ fun that we didn't want to leave.
These are ___ juicy mangoes that I want more.
groups.rule_vi: **such + (a/an) + adj + danh từ + that**. Dấu hiệu: có danh từ như ==a long walk==, ==fun==, ==juicy mangoes==. __Danh từ không đếm được hoặc số nhiều thì bỏ a/an.__

unjumble.sentence: My grandpa is fitter than most young people I know.
unjumble.hint_vi: So sánh hơn của tính từ ngắn: fit → fitter than
unjumble.why_vi: Chủ ngữ + is + **fitter than** + người được so sánh. fit gấp đôi t: ==fitter==. __Tính từ ngắn tận cùng phụ âm–nguyên âm–phụ âm thì gấp đôi phụ âm cuối.__

unjumble.sentence: Swimming is one of the best ways to stay fit.
unjumble.hint_vi: So sánh nhất: one of the best + danh từ số nhiều
unjumble.why_vi: **one of the best + danh từ số nhiều**: ==one of the best ways== rồi tới to stay fit. __Sau 'one of' luôn là danh từ số nhiều.__

unjumble.sentence: He isn't old enough to work out at the gym.
unjumble.why_vi: **adj + enough + to V**: ==old enough to work out==; isn't đứng ngay sau He. __enough đứng sau tính từ.__

unjumble.sentence: This salad is too big for me to finish.
unjumble.hint_vi: too + adj + for sb + to V
unjumble.why_vi: **too + adj + for sb + to V**: ==too big for me to finish==. __'for me' nằm giữa tính từ và 'to V'.__

unjumble.sentence: The match was so tiring that I went to bed early.
unjumble.why_vi: **so + adj + that + mệnh đề**: ==so tiring that== I went to bed early. __Sau that là một câu đầy đủ chủ ngữ + động từ.__

truefalse.s: My brother is enough tall to play basketball.
truefalse.fix: My brother is tall enough to play basketball.
truefalse.why_vi: Sai. ==enough tall== → **tall enough**: enough đứng SAU tính từ. __Nhớ: adj + enough, nhưng enough + danh từ.__

truefalse.s: Cycling is more healthier than taking the bus.
truefalse.fix: Cycling is healthier than taking the bus.
truefalse.why_vi: Sai. ==more healthier== thừa more → **healthier than**. __Đã có -er thì không thêm more.__

truefalse.s: This is the most nutritious breakfast I have ever had.
truefalse.fix: This is the most nutritious breakfast I have ever had.
truefalse.why_vi: Đúng. Tính từ dài ==nutritious== → **the most nutritious**, hay đi với ==I have ever had==. __Gặp 'I have ever…' thường là so sánh nhất.__

truefalse.s: It was such a long race that many runners gave up.
truefalse.fix: It was such a long race that many runners gave up.
truefalse.why_vi: Đúng. ==such a long race that== theo đúng mẫu **such + a + adj + danh từ số ít + that**.

truefalse.s: We don't have enough time to cook a proper dinner.
truefalse.fix: We don't have enough time to cook a proper dinner.
truefalse.why_vi: Đúng. ==enough time==: **enough đứng TRƯỚC danh từ**. __Với tính từ thì ngược lại: old enough.__

truefalse.s: The weather was so hot that we couldn't work out outside.
truefalse.fix: The weather was so hot that we couldn't work out outside.
truefalse.why_vi: Đúng. Sau so chỉ có tính từ ==hot== (không có danh từ) → **so + adj + that**.

truefalse.s: My cold is badder than it was yesterday.
truefalse.fix: My cold is worse than it was yesterday.
truefalse.why_vi: Sai. ==badder== không có; bad là bất quy tắc → **worse** (bad – worse – the worst). __Học thuộc good/better, bad/worse, far/further.__

truefalse.s: It was so a delicious soup that I had two bowls.
truefalse.fix: It was such a delicious soup that I had two bowls.
truefalse.why_vi: Sai. Có ==a delicious soup== (a + tính từ + danh từ) → phải dùng **such**, không dùng so. __so đứng trước tính từ một mình, such đứng trước cụm danh từ.__

exam.intro_vi: Đề Chuyên Ngoại ngữ có 5 câu chọn câu gần nghĩa nhất với câu cho sẵn, mỗi câu 4 lựa chọn. Câu gốc hay dùng so sánh, too/enough, so/such; đáp án là cách nói khác giữ nguyên nghĩa.
exam.tip_vi: Mẹo: tách câu gốc thành từng ý nhỏ (ai hơn ai, làm được hay không), loại câu bị đảo nghĩa và câu sai ngữ pháp như 'such heavy'.

items.q: My brother doesn't run as fast as I do.
options: My brother runs faster than me.
I run faster than my brother.
My brother and I run equally fast.
I don't run as fast as my brother.
items.explain_vi: ==doesn't run as fast as I do== nghĩa là anh chạy chậm hơn em → **I run faster than my brother**. __Đổi chủ ngữ thì đảo chiều so sánh; A bị ngược nghĩa.__

items.q: The bag was so heavy that Lan couldn't lift it.
options: The bag was heavy enough for Lan to lift.
The bag was such heavy that Lan couldn't lift it.
Lan was strong enough to lift the bag.
The bag was too heavy for Lan to lift.
items.explain_vi: ==so heavy that Lan couldn't lift it== → **too heavy for Lan to lift**. __'such heavy' sai vì such phải có danh từ đi sau.__

items.q: I have never eaten such a nutritious meal.
options: This is the most nutritious meal I have ever eaten.
I have eaten more nutritious meals than this.
This meal is less nutritious than other meals I have eaten.
I never eat nutritious meals.
items.explain_vi: ==never ... such a nutritious meal== → bữa ăn bổ nhất từng ăn: **the most nutritious meal I have ever eaten**. __never + such a ↔ the most … ever.__

items.q: Thu is not tall enough to reach the top shelf.
options: Thu is tall enough to reach the top shelf.
Thu is too short to reach the top shelf.
Thu is so tall that she can reach the top shelf.
The top shelf is too low for Thu to reach.
items.explain_vi: ==not tall enough to reach== → **too short to reach**: không đủ cao nên không với tới. __D sai: kệ thấp thì lại với được.__

items.q: Fast food is less healthy than home-cooked food.
options: Fast food is as healthy as home-cooked food.
Fast food is healthier than home-cooked food.
Home-cooked food is healthier than fast food.
Home-cooked food is not as healthy as fast food.
items.explain_vi: ==less healthy than== → đảo hai vế: **Home-cooked food is healthier than fast food**. __D cũng ngược nghĩa vì nói fast food tốt hơn.__

exam.intro_vi: Đề Sở chuyên Anh Hà Nội có phần viết lại câu bắt đầu bằng từ cho sẵn, giữ nguyên nghĩa; đề chung vào 10 cũng có dạng này. Hôm nay em luyện 5 câu với so sánh, too/enough, so/such.
exam.tip_vi: Mẹo: viết xong đọc lại cả câu mới và so với câu gốc: nghĩa có giữ nguyên không, thì có đúng không, chủ ngữ mới đã hợp chưa?

items.q: This test is easier than the last one.
items.explain_vi: ==easier than the last one== → đổi chủ ngữ thì dùng tính từ trái nghĩa: **more difficult / harder than this one**. __Đổi chủ ngữ là phải đổi chiều so sánh.__

items.q: My little brother is too short to ride this roller coaster.
items.answer: tall enough to ride this roller coaster
items.explain_vi: ==too short to ride== → **not tall enough to ride**: too + adj thành not + tính từ trái nghĩa + enough. __enough đứng sau tall.__

items.q: The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
items.answer: such a boring film that I fell asleep
items.explain_vi: ==so boring that== → **such a boring film that I fell asleep**. __Câu mới bắt đầu 'It was' nên phải thêm a + danh từ film.__

items.q: Nobody in my family cooks as well as my grandma.
items.explain_vi: ==Nobody ... cooks as well as my grandma== → bà nấu ngon nhất: **the best cook in my family**. __Sau 'the best' cần danh từ cook (người nấu).__

items.q: The exercise was too difficult for me to do.
items.answer: difficult that I couldn't do it
accept: difficult that I could not do it
difficult that I wasn't able to do it
difficult that I was not able to do it
items.explain_vi: ==too difficult for me to do== → **so difficult that I couldn't do it**. __Nhớ thêm tân ngữ 'it' sau do và dùng couldn't vì câu ở quá khứ.__

exam_easy.intro_vi: Đề Chuyên Ngoại ngữ có dạng đọc một câu rồi chọn câu A, B, C hoặc D có nghĩa giống nhất. Bản này câu ngắn, từ quen; em chỉ cần chú ý ai hơn ai, làm được hay không.
exam_easy.tip_vi: Mẹo: gạch chân từ so sánh (taller, the best, too, enough). Nếu đổi chủ ngữ thì đổi tính từ sang nghĩa ngược lại: taller → shorter.

items.q: Minh is taller than Nam.
options: Nam is taller than Minh.
Nam is shorter than Minh.
Minh is shorter than Nam.
Minh and Nam are the same height.
items.explain_vi: ==Minh is taller than Nam== → Nam thấp hơn Minh: **Nam is shorter than Minh**. __Đưa Nam lên đầu thì đổi taller thành shorter.__

items.q: The tea is too hot to drink.
options: The tea is cool enough to drink.
The tea isn't cool enough to drink.
The tea isn't hot.
I drink hot tea every day.
items.explain_vi: ==too hot to drink== nghĩa là chưa uống được → **isn't cool enough to drink**. __Câu A 'cool enough' là ngược nghĩa, để ý chữ isn't.__

items.q: Hoa is the best swimmer in our class.
options: Hoa swims better than everyone else in our class.
Hoa can't swim.
Everyone in our class swims better than Hoa.
Hoa is a bad swimmer.
items.explain_vi: ==the best swimmer== là bơi giỏi nhất → **swims better than everyone else**. __C ngược nghĩa vì nói mọi người bơi giỏi hơn Hoa.__

items.q: It was such a cold day that we stayed at home.
options: The day was warm, so we went out.
We went out because it was cold.
The day was so cold that we stayed at home.
It was a hot day, so we stayed at home.
items.explain_vi: ==such a cold day that== → **so cold that we stayed at home**. __Các câu khác đổi nghĩa (warm, went out, hot), loại ngay.__

items.q: Cycling is healthier than watching TV.
options: Watching TV is healthier than cycling.
Cycling is as healthy as watching TV.
Cycling isn't healthy.
Watching TV isn't as healthy as cycling.
items.explain_vi: ==healthier than watching TV== → xem TV không tốt bằng: **isn't as healthy as cycling**. __Dùng not as … as thì giữ được tính từ healthy.__

exam_easy.intro_vi: Đề Sở chuyên Anh Hà Nội và đề chung vào 10 có phần viết lại câu, phần đầu câu mới cho sẵn. Bản này câu ngắn: em chỉ cần đổi so sánh, too/enough hoặc so/such.
exam_easy.tip_vi: Mẹo: too + tính từ = not + tính từ ngược nghĩa + enough (too small = not big enough). such cần a + tính từ + danh từ.

items.q: Lan is shorter than her sister.
items.explain_vi: ==Lan is shorter than her sister== → chị cao hơn: **taller than Lan**. __Đổi chủ ngữ thì đổi tính từ sang nghĩa ngược lại.__

items.q: My shoes are too small for me to wear.
items.answer: big enough for me to wear
accept: large enough for me to wear
items.explain_vi: ==too small== → **not big enough for me to wear**. __enough đứng SAU tính từ: big enough.__

items.q: The cake was so delicious that I ate three pieces.
items.answer: such a delicious cake that I ate three pieces
items.explain_vi: ==so delicious that== → **such a delicious cake that**. __Phải thêm mạo từ a và danh từ cake.__

items.q: No one in my class is as tall as Đức.
items.explain_vi: ==No one ... as tall as Đức== → **the tallest student in my class**. __Tính từ ngắn thêm -est.__

items.q: I am not old enough to drive a car.
items.explain_vi: ==not old enough== → **too young to drive a car**. __Sau too + tính từ là to + động từ.__

exam_plus.intro_vi: Trong đề Chuyên Ngoại ngữ, các câu gần nghĩa cuối phần thường là câu phân loại: phương án nhiễu chỉ lệch một chữ như slightly/much, few/little, hoặc đảo ngược ý rất khéo.
exam_plus.tip_vi: Mẹo: so từng chữ chỉ mức độ (hardly, nearly, much, slightly) và kiểm tra ngữ pháp từng phương án trước khi so nghĩa.

items.q: Hardly anyone in the team is as fit as Quang.
options: Quang is the least fit player in the team.
Almost everyone in the team is fitter than Quang.
Quang is fitter than almost everyone else in the team.
Quang is as fit as most of the players in the team.
items.explain_vi: ==Hardly anyone ... as fit as Quang== → hầu như không ai khoẻ bằng Quang → **fitter than almost everyone else**. __hardly anyone là gần như không ai, đừng hiểu thành 'ai cũng'.__

items.q: The more you exercise, the more energy you will have.
options: If you exercise more, you will have more energy.
You will have more energy if you exercise less.
Exercising gives you less energy than resting.
However much you exercise, your energy stays the same.
items.explain_vi: ==The more ..., the more ...== nghĩa là càng … càng … → **If you exercise more, you will have more energy**. __B sai vì đổi more thành less.__

items.q: There weren't enough doctors to treat all the injured fans.
options: There were too few doctors to treat all the injured fans.
There were too little doctors to treat all the injured fans.
There were so many doctors that all the injured fans were treated.
Not all the doctors were needed to treat the injured fans.
items.explain_vi: ==weren't enough doctors== → **too few doctors** (danh từ đếm được). __'too little' chỉ đi với danh từ không đếm được nên B sai.__

items.q: The instructions were too complicated for the patients to follow.
options: The instructions were complicated enough for the patients to follow.
The instructions were so complicated that the patients couldn't follow them.
Although the instructions were complicated, the patients followed them.
The patients were such complicated that they couldn't follow the instructions.
items.explain_vi: ==too complicated for the patients to follow== → **so complicated that the patients couldn't follow them**. __D sai: such không đứng trước tính từ một mình.__

items.q: My grandmother's health is not nearly as good as it used to be.
options: My grandmother's health is slightly worse than it used to be.
My grandmother's health is almost as good as it used to be.
My grandmother's health is better than it used to be.
My grandmother's health is much worse than it used to be.
items.explain_vi: ==not nearly as good as== là kém xa → **much worse**. __Bẫy: 'slightly worse' sai mức độ; 'almost as good' lừa vì nearly giống almost.__

exam_plus.intro_vi: Câu viết lại khó trong đề Sở chuyên Anh thường kết hợp hai điểm: so sánh kép the more…, the more…, such với danh từ không đếm được, hoặc cụm động từ cùng enough. Đây là câu phân loại.
exam_plus.tip_vi: Mẹo: advice, information, news không đếm được nên không có a: such useful advice. Viết xong đọc lại cả câu, kiểm tra tân ngữ và thì.

items.q: Phong recovered from his injury too slowly to play in the final.
items.answer: his injury quickly enough to play in the final
accept: his injury fast enough to play in the final
items.explain_vi: ==recovered from== đổi thành get over; ==too slowly== → **his injury quickly enough to play in the final**. __enough đứng sau trạng từ: quickly enough.__

items.q: She is the most energetic person I have ever met.
accept: met such an energetic person before
met a more energetic person than her
met anyone more energetic than her
met anyone as energetic as her
met a person as energetic as her
met anyone as energetic as she is
items.explain_vi: ==the most energetic person I have ever met== → **met such an energetic person**. __energetic bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm nên dùng an.__

items.q: As my grandfather gets older, he finds it harder to walk long distances.
items.answer: the harder he finds it to walk long distances
accept: the more difficult he finds it to walk long distances
the harder it is for him to walk long distances
the more difficult it is for him to walk long distances
items.explain_vi: ==As ... gets older, ... harder== → so sánh kép: **the harder he finds it to walk long distances**. __Cả hai vế đều phải có the + so sánh hơn.__

items.q: The doctor's advice was so useful that I followed it immediately.
items.answer: such useful advice that I followed it immediately
items.explain_vi: ==advice== không đếm được → **such useful advice that**, không có a. __Không viết 'such a useful advice'; information, news cũng vậy.__

items.q: In our club, no exercise is as tiring as the hill run.
items.answer: the most tiring exercise in our club
accept: more tiring than any other exercise in our club
the most tiring exercise of all in our club
items.explain_vi: ==no exercise is as tiring as the hill run== → **the most tiring exercise in our club**. __Cũng có thể viết more tiring than any other exercise.__

paper_plus.instruction_vi: Câu 1–2: viết dạng đúng của từ in hoa (từ phải đổi hai lần). Câu 3–4: viết tiếp câu mới sao cho nghĩa không đổi. Câu 5–6: chọn A, B, C hoặc D.

items.q: The doctor said that my grandfather's heart problems were caused by years of ______. (ACTIVE)
items.explain_vi: Sau ==years of== cần **danh từ**: active → inactive → **inactivity** (sự ít vận động). __Từ đổi hai lần: thêm tiền tố phủ định rồi đổi sang danh từ.__

items.q: Eating a heavy meal late at night can have some ______ effects on your sleep. (DESIRE)
items.explain_vi: Trước danh từ ==effects== cần tính từ; ăn khuya có hại → nghĩa phủ định: **undesirable**. __desire → desirable → undesirable.__

items.q: Nobody in the club works out as regularly as my uncle. → My uncle works out ______
items.answer: more regularly than anybody else in the club
accept: more regularly than anyone else in the club
more regularly than any other member of the club
more regularly than any other club member
items.explain_vi: ==Nobody ... works out as regularly as my uncle== → **more regularly than anybody else in the club**. __Phải có 'else' hoặc 'other' để không so sánh chú với chính mình.__

items.q: The gym is too small for all the members to use at the same time. → The gym isn't ______
items.answer: big enough for all the members to use at the same time
accept: large enough for all the members to use at the same time
big enough for all members to use at the same time
large enough for all members to use at the same time
items.explain_vi: ==too small for all the members to use== → **isn't big enough for all the members to use at the same time**. __too + adj ↔ not + tính từ trái nghĩa + enough.__

items.q: After a week in bed with flu, Hùng was still feeling a bit under the ______, so he didn't go to football practice.
options: rain
sky
weather
cloud
items.explain_vi: Thành ngữ **under the weather** (C) nghĩa là hơi mệt, không khoẻ; khớp với ==After a week in bed with flu==. __Thành ngữ phải học nguyên cụm, không đoán từng từ.__

items.q: After his check-up, my dad decided to ______ a healthier lifestyle: no more fizzy drinks and no more late nights.
options: adapt
adopt
accept
adjust
items.explain_vi: **adopt a lifestyle** (B) là theo một lối sống mới, khớp với ==no more fizzy drinks and no more late nights==. __Dễ nhầm: adapt là thích nghi, adjust là điều chỉnh.__

hints.d5C1: tính từ (nghĩa ngược lại của healthy)
hints.d5C4: động từ (chủ ngữ I, hiện tại đơn)

writing_starters: I think I am healthier than … because …
One of my good habits is …
However, I have a bad habit: I …
I want to change this habit because …

part1.intro_vi: Em nghe Linh và Nam nói chuyện về bữa sáng và việc tập thể dục. Chọn đáp án đúng cho mỗi câu hỏi.

script.t: Hi Nam. You look so tired this morning. Are you Okay?
I'm fine, but I didn't have breakfast today. I got up too late to eat.
Oh no. Breakfast gives you energy for the whole morning. What do you usually eat?
Usually just a sweet cake and a cup of milk tea.
Well, that's not very nutritious. I always have some eggs and bread, or a bowl of pho.
Eggs are easier to cook than pho. Maybe I'll try that.
Good idea. And do you do any exercise?
Not much, actually. I play football on Sundays, that's all.
Why don't you come jogging with me in the park? I go every Tuesday and Thursday after school.
Okay, I'll come on Thursday. Thanks, Linh!

items.q: Why didn't Nam have breakfast today?
options: He wasn't hungry.
He got up too late.
There was no food at home.
He wanted to lose weight.
items.explain_vi: Nam nói: ==I got up too late to eat.== → **He got up too late**. __Câu hỏi Why → nghe lý do ngay sau chỗ nói không ăn sáng.__

items.q: What does Nam usually have for breakfast?
options: A bowl of pho
Eggs and bread
A sweet cake and milk tea
Nothing at all
items.explain_vi: Nam: ==Usually just a sweet cake and a cup of milk tea.== → **A sweet cake and milk tea**. __Trứng, bánh mì, phở là bữa sáng của Linh: nghe rõ ai nói.__

items.q: What does Linh say about breakfast?
options: It gives you energy.
It takes too long to cook.
It is not important.
It makes you tired.
items.explain_vi: Linh nói: ==Breakfast gives you energy for the whole morning.== → **It gives you energy**.

items.q: When does Nam play football?
options: Every day
After school
On Tuesdays
On Sundays
items.explain_vi: Nam: ==I play football on Sundays, that's all.== → **On Sundays**. __Thứ Ba, thứ Năm là ngày Linh chạy bộ, đừng nhầm.__

items.q: When will Nam go jogging with Linh?
options: On Tuesday
On Thursday
On Sunday
On Saturday
items.explain_vi: Linh chạy thứ Ba và thứ Năm, nhưng Nam nói: ==Okay, I'll come on Thursday.== → **On Thursday**. __Nghe câu trả lời cuối của người được rủ.__

part2.intro_vi: Em nghe thầy giáo thể dục thông báo về Tuần lễ Sức khoẻ của trường. Điền một từ hoặc một con số vào mỗi chỗ trống.
part2.script: Hello, everyone. This is Mr Brown, your sports teacher. Next week is our school Health Week, and we've got lots of fun activities for you. On Monday morning, a doctor is coming to talk to us about healthy food. Please bring a notebook, because you'll need to write down some tips. On Wednesday afternoon, there's a fun run around the school. It's only 2 kilometres long, so it isn't too hard for anyone. Please wear trainers, not sandals. On Friday, we're having a fruit party in the canteen. Every student should bring one piece of fruit. If you have any questions, come and see me in the sports hall. Thank you!
part2.text:
SCHOOL HEALTH WEEK
• Monday: a [1] talks about healthy food
• Bring: a [2]
• Wednesday: fun run, [3] kilometres
• Wear: [4]
• Friday: fruit party in the [5]

items.explain_vi: Thầy nói: ==a doctor is coming to talk to us about healthy food.== → **doctor**. __Sau 'a' cần danh từ chỉ người.__
==Please bring a notebook== → **notebook**. __Có thể viết 'a notebook' cũng được.__
==It's only 2 kilometres long.== → **2** (hoặc two).
==Please wear trainers, not sandals.== → **trainers**. __Cẩn thận chữ 'not': sandals là thứ không được đi.__
==On Friday, we're having a fruit party in the canteen.== → **canteen**.

part1.intro_vi: Em nghe Mai hỏi thăm Tom về chấn thương ở chân. Chú ý: có chỗ người nói nói nhầm rồi sửa lại. Chọn đáp án đúng.

script.t: Hi Tom! Why are you walking so slowly? What happened?
Oh, I hurt my ankle at basketball practice on Monday. Well, actually, it was Tuesday. I jumped for the ball and landed badly.
Ouch! Is it serious? Have you seen a doctor?
Yes, my mum took me. At first I thought I'd only need a week off, but the doctor said I can't play for three weeks.
Three weeks? But the school match is in two weeks. That's so soon.
I know. My ankle won't be strong enough to play by then. The coach is going to ask Ben to take my place.
That's a shame. So what are you doing to get over it?
I rest it a lot and put ice on it. The doctor also told me to eat more nutritious food, like fish and green vegetables, so it gets better faster.
My dad had the same injury last year. When it started to feel better, he went swimming. He said it was much gentler than running.
Swimming? That's a good idea. I'm so bored at home, doing nothing.
Why don't you come to the pool with me next weekend? Well, ask your doctor first, of course.
Sure. I'll ask him on Friday, when I go back for a check.

items.q: When did Tom hurt his ankle?
options: On Monday
At the weekend
On Tuesday
On Friday
items.explain_vi: Tom nói Monday rồi sửa: ==Well, actually, it was Tuesday.== → **On Tuesday**. __Thông tin sau 'actually' mới là đáp án.__

items.q: For how long does Tom have to stop playing basketball?
options: Three weeks
One week
Two weeks
A month
items.explain_vi: Tom kể bác sĩ nói: ==I can't play for three weeks.== → **Three weeks**. __Một tuần là Tom tưởng lúc đầu; hai tuần là lúc có trận đấu.__

items.q: What did the doctor tell Tom to do?
options: Go swimming every day
Play only short games
Stop eating fish
Eat healthier food
items.explain_vi: ==The doctor also told me to eat more nutritious food== → **Eat healthier food**. __Bơi là gợi ý của Mai, không phải của bác sĩ.__

items.q: Why did Mai's dad go swimming?
options: It was cheaper than going to the gym.
It was easier on his body than running.
His doctor told him to.
He wanted to lose weight.
items.explain_vi: Mai: ==He said it was much gentler than running.== → **It was easier on his body than running**. __'gentler' được nói lại thành 'easier on his body'.__

items.q: What will Tom do on Friday?
options: Play in the school match
Go to the pool with Mai
Ask the doctor about swimming
Start basketball practice again
items.explain_vi: Tom: ==I'll ask him on Friday== (hỏi bác sĩ về việc bơi) → **Ask the doctor about swimming**. __Đi bơi với Mai là cuối tuần sau, không phải thứ Sáu.__

part2.intro_vi: Em nghe giới thiệu khoá thể dục mùa hè cho tuổi teen. Có một chỗ người nói sửa lại thông tin. Điền 1–2 từ hoặc một con số.
part2.script: Hello and welcome to Green Park Sports Centre. My name is Anna, and I'm going to tell you about our summer fitness course for teenagers. The course starts in June and lasts for 6 weeks. Classes are on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, early in the morning, because it's too hot to exercise in the afternoon. In the first hour, you'll work out in the gym with a trainer. After that, you can choose swimming or yoga. Oh, sorry, I made a mistake. It's swimming or dancing. Yoga classes are only for adults this summer. Every student must bring a water bottle and a towel. Please don't bring crisps or sweet drinks. We give everyone a free, nutritious snack after class, usually fruit and yoghurt. To sign up, just fill in a form at the reception desk.
part2.text:
SUMMER FITNESS COURSE
• Length: [1] weeks
• First hour: work out in the gym with a [2]
• After that: swimming or [3]
• Bring: a water bottle and a [4]
• Free snack: fruit and [5]

items.explain_vi: Anna nói: ==The course starts in June and lasts for 6 weeks.== → **6**.
==you'll work out in the gym with a trainer== → **trainer**. __Ở đây trainer là huấn luyện viên, không phải giày.__
Anna nói yoga rồi sửa: ==It's swimming or dancing.== → **dancing**. __Nghe 'sorry, I made a mistake' là biết thông tin sắp đổi.__
==Every student must bring a water bottle and a towel.== → **towel**.
==usually fruit and yoghurt== → **yoghurt** (viết yogurt cũng được). __Crisps và sweet drinks là đồ không được mang, đừng nhầm.__

part1.intro_vi: Em nghe Anna và Nam bàn cách lấy lại thể lực trước buổi tuyển cầu thủ bóng đá. Câu hỏi về ý kiến, thái độ và suy luận.

script.t: So, Nam, have you decided how you're going to get fit before the football trials?
Well, I was going to join that new gym near the market, but honestly, it's far more expensive than I expected.
And to be honest, I'm not sure a gym is the best choice for football anyway. You need stamina more than big muscles.
That's what my coach said, actually. He thinks I'm strong enough, but I get out of breath too quickly in the second half of a match.
Then why don't you come to the running club? We meet in the park by the lake at six o'clock every morning.
Six o'clock? That's far too early for me. I can hardly get up at seven.
I felt exactly the same at first, believe me. But after a couple of weeks, it became a habit, and now I have more energy at school than I used to.
Really? I always assumed that getting up early would make me sleepier in class.
Only if you stay up late on your phone. You have to go to bed earlier. That's the real secret.
Hmm, that's the hard part. I usually watch football highlights until midnight.
Well, it's up to you. But the trials are in a month, so you haven't got much time.
You're right. Okay, I'll give it a try for a week and see how I feel. But I'm not giving up my football videos completely! Maybe just on weekdays.
Deal. Oh, and don't come without eating anything. Last week a new boy felt dizzy halfway round the lake.
Don't worry. I'll have a banana before I leave.

items.q: What problem does Nam mention about the gym?
options: It is too far from his house.
It costs more than he thought.
It doesn't open early enough.
It is always too crowded.
items.explain_vi: Nam: ==it's far more expensive than I expected== → **It costs more than he thought**. __Đắt hơn dự tính, không phải xa nhà.__

items.q: According to Nam's coach, what is Nam's main weakness?
options: He isn't strong enough.
He is often late for practice.
He gets tired too quickly during a match.
He doesn't eat a balanced diet.
items.explain_vi: ==He thinks I'm strong enough, but I get out of breath too quickly== → **He gets tired too quickly during a match**. __Ý sau 'but' mới là điểm yếu; A sai vì Nam đủ khoẻ.__

items.q: When Anna says "I felt exactly the same at first", she means that
options: she also found getting up early difficult.
she used to love running in the morning.
she was also worried about the football trials.
she also watched football late at night.
items.explain_vi: Anna đáp lại câu Nam than ==That's far too early for me. I can hardly get up at seven.== → **she also found getting up early difficult**. __Xem câu ngay trước để hiểu 'the same' là gì.__

items.q: What does Anna say is "the real secret"?
options: Getting up at seven
Running with friends
Eating before running
Sleeping earlier at night
items.explain_vi: Anna: ==You have to go to bed earlier. That's the real secret.== → **Sleeping earlier at night**. __Ăn chuối chỉ là lời dặn thêm.__

items.q: What can we infer about Nam at the end of the conversation?
options: He will stop watching football videos completely.
He thinks the running club is a waste of time.
He has agreed to try the running club for a short time.
He will join the gym after the trials.
items.explain_vi: Nam: ==I'll give it a try for a week== → **He has agreed to try the running club for a short time**. __A sai vì Nam nói không bỏ hẳn video bóng đá.__

part2.intro_vi: Em nghe bác sĩ nói với học sinh về đồ uống khi tập thể thao. Bài có nhiều thông tin gây nhiễu. Điền 1–2 từ hoặc một con số.
part2.script: Good morning, everyone. I'm Doctor Anna Green, and I work with young athletes. Today I'd like to talk about something most of you do every day without thinking: drinking. Many teenagers believe that sports drinks are the best choice after exercise. Some people say you need them after just 30 minutes of sport, but in fact, for any workout shorter than 60 minutes, plain water is perfectly enough. Sports drinks contain so much sugar that one bottle can have as much as 8 teaspoons. Energy drinks are even worse, because they also contain caffeine, which can seriously damage your sleep. Now, most people think the first sign that you need water is feeling thirsty. Actually, by then your body is already short of water. So watch out for earlier signs, such as headaches, or finding that you suddenly can't concentrate. And what should you eat after training? Many of you reach for crisps or a cake. Chocolate isn't a terrible choice, surprisingly, but my top recommendation is a banana and a glass of milk. It's cheap, quick and far more nutritious than most snacks.
part2.text:
DRINKS AND EXERCISE
• Plain water is enough for workouts shorter than [1] minutes
• One bottle of sports drink: up to [2] teaspoons of sugar
• Caffeine in energy drinks can damage your [3]
• Early warning signs: headaches, being unable to [4]
• Best snack after training: a [5] and a glass of milk

items.explain_vi: ==for any workout shorter than 60 minutes, plain water is perfectly enough== → **60**. __Số 30 là ý kiến bị bác bỏ bằng 'but in fact'.__
==one bottle can have as much as 8 teaspoons== → **8**.
==caffeine, which can seriously damage your sleep== → **sleep**.
==such as headaches, or finding that you suddenly can't concentrate== → **concentrate**. __Khát nước là dấu hiệu muộn, không phải dấu hiệu sớm.__
==my top recommendation is a banana and a glass of milk== → **banana**. __Chocolate chỉ 'không tệ', không phải lựa chọn tốt nhất.__
